_contract: PINNED by docs/BUILD_PLAN.md (P4). A disappointing model is a DATA problem - changing these numbers to chase metrics is prohibited; ask first. training/modal_app.py reads every number from this file and never duplicates one in code.

base_model._note: Qwen3 dropped the -Instruct suffix: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B IS the post-trained chat variant (Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Instruct does not exist on the Hub; Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Base is the pretrain-only repo). BUILD_PLAN's phrase 'Qwen3-1.7B-Instruct' resolves to this repo. This revision MUST equal the revision in configs/models.json:base - tests/test_training_config.py enforces it.

_smoke_overrides_note: --smoke merges these on top of the resolved config. A key naming a top-level section deep-merges into that section; any other key merges into 'training'. So max_steps lands in training.max_steps, where HF TrainingArguments lets it supersede num_train_epochs.

data._note: Pivot schema (docs/PIVOT_DESIGN.md, Data models): {"messages": [user, assistant], "constraints": [...], "provenance": {...}}. There is NO system message and training/modal_app.py will not synthesise one. The training condition is bound to the eval condition by prompt_renderer, not by a system prompt: every row's user message is re-rendered through that shared function and must come back byte-identical before a GPU-second is spent. enable_thinking must still match the eval generator's chat-template call.
data._prompt_renderer_note: DECLARED ASSUMPTION, to be reconciled at integration: the shared scenario -> user-message renderer written by the scenarios/harness lane, called render(scenario, constraint_lookup) -> str (or render(scenario) at arity 1) -- deliberately the same call scripts/check_loop.py makes, so the writer and the validator of train_log.json agree. It did not exist on disk when training/modal_app.py was adapted. If the lane published it under another name, change THIS STRING -- do not add a second renderer in training code, because a second implementation of the prompt is the drift this contract exists to prevent. scenarios_path/constraints_path resolve rows that reference a scenario or constraint by id; they are copied into train_log.dataset so an offline checker can resolve the same ids.
